content: CRM commonly refers to a Customer Relationship Management system such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Microsoft Dynamics 365, used to manage customer interactions and sales pipelines.
GPT refers to a generative pre-trained transformer large language model (e.g. OpenAI GPT-4, Azure OpenAI Service) used for natural language generation tasks.

keywords: customer support, service desk, help desk
content: Customer Support (also called Customer Service or Help Desk) is the department responsible for resolving customer inquiries and issues across channels such as email, chat, and phone.
Outlook refers to Microsoft Outlook, the enterprise email and calendaring client, commonly integrated with Microsoft 365 services.

keywords: production, prod, live, 生产环境
content: Production (or 'live', in Chinese '生产环境') refers to the environment serving real end users and real data, as opposed to staging, test, or sandbox environments.

keywords: human review, manual approval, human-in-the-loop, 人工复核
content: Removing 'manual approval' or 'human review' (in Chinese, '人工复核' or '人工审批') from a workflow indicates a shift toward full automation (human-out-of-the-loop).
Copilot generally refers to Microsoft 365 Copilot, an AI assistant embedded in Office applications such as Word, Excel, Teams, and Outlook.
'老板' is Chinese for 'boss' and typically signals that a request originates from, or is endorsed by, an executive or senior leadership stakeholder.
Finance (including Accounts Payable) is the department responsible for payment processing, refunds, invoicing, and financial controls.
Marketing is the department responsible for campaigns, customer acquisition, and brand communication; it may request access to customer or analytics data.
The customer database (or Customer Data Platform / CDP) stores customer profile, contact, and transaction records used across sales, support, and marketing systems.

keywords: auto-approve, 自动审批, no human review
content: 'Auto-approve' (Chinese: '自动审批') combined with no human review is a strong signal of reduced human oversight in a financial or operational decision process.
A request that links two or more existing enterprise systems together (e.g. email to CRM) is typically a 'System Integration' request type.
A request to introduce a new AI model or assistant into a business process (e.g. deploying Copilot or GPT) is typically a 'Model Deployment' request type.

keywords: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, external AI vendor
content: References to GPT, Copilot, or similar assistants usually imply an external AI service provider such as OpenAI or Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service.
